title: Writes in a linked worktree must not edit the tracked .slicer/.gitignore
lead: In a linked worktree, slicer adds a missing ignore line to the repo's `info/exclude` instead of the tracked `.slicer/.gitignore`, and `slicer check` warns when `.slicer/.gitignore` lacks a line `init` writes, naming the command that adds them on main.
findings_note: nested-relay trial idea0, 2026-10-15: relay-run begin changed .slicer/.gitignore in the slice commit
boundary:
**Not in this slice:**
- Where the relay-run ledger lives (its own item; once it is in the common dir it needs no ignore line in a git repo).
- Removing lines from `info/exclude` later.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The idea0 nested-relay trial on 2026-10-15: `relay-run begin` in a fresh slice worktree modified `.slicer/.gitignore`, so that change went into the slice commit. The project was made before `init` listed every line, and `feedback.ensure_gitignore` is called on every write: the project lock (`src/slicer/store.py`, "a project made before init listed the lock gets the line on its next write"), the feedback log, and the relay-run ledger. Whichever write comes first in a worktree puts an unrelated tracking change on that slice's branch. The owner chose on 2026-10-15: the exclude file in a linked worktree, plus a check warning.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/feedback.py`, `ensure_gitignore`: when the root is a linked worktree (its git dir differs from the common dir), add the missing entry to `<git common dir>/info/exclude` as `**/.slicer/<name>` and leave `.slicer/.gitignore` alone. In the main worktree and outside git, today's behaviour. Same advisory rule as now: an unwritable file never blocks the write.
- `src/slicer/vcs.py`: a helper that says whether a root is a linked worktree.
- `src/slicer/check.py`: a warning when `.slicer/.gitignore` lacks any line `init` writes (`feedback.md`, the sidecar, `relay-runs.jsonl`, `lock`), naming `slicer setup-git --attributes` on main as the fix.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `setup-git --attributes`: also adds the missing `.slicer/.gitignore` lines, and its help says so.
- `docs/commands.md` (`setup-git`, `check`), `docs/agents.md` if the check JSON gains a warning code, `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `tests/test_feedback.py`, `tests/test_atomic.py` (the lock line), `tests/test_cli.py` for check and setup-git.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_EnsureGitignore_LinkedWorktree_WritesInfoExclude`: in a linked worktree whose `.slicer/.gitignore` lacks `lock`, a write leaves `.slicer/.gitignore` unchanged and `git status --short` clean, and `info/exclude` holds `**/.slicer/lock`.
- `test_EnsureGitignore_MainWorktree_EditsSlicerGitignore`: in the main checkout the line goes into `.slicer/.gitignore` as today.
- `test_Check_WarnsOnMissingGitignoreLine`: `check --json` warns and names `setup-git --attributes`.
- `test_SetupGitAttributes_AddsMissingGitignoreLines`: after it, the warning is gone.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red, one mutation each.
2. Add the linked-worktree branch in `ensure_gitignore`, then the check warning and the setup-git write.
3. Update the docs and the CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s300`, branch `feature/s300-worktree-gitignore`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
